value.message: Oakville has Preschool A Learn to Swim Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for 3-5 year olds (no parent in water) - their site says, with fees set by Council in the current Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Tues Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I'll keep watching and text you once the fee is posted.
